program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i | is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_b@j, is_a@i)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_b@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i, is_a@i & !is_b@i | is_a@i & is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j)
h1_3 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i, is_a@i | !is_b@i)
h2_1 = rightmost(is_bos@i & is_a@i & !is_b@i & h1_1@i & h1_2@i & h1_3@i & is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h1_3@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i, is_a@i & !is_b@i | !is_b@i)
h2_2 = leftmost(is_bos@i & !is_a@i & is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_1@j & h1_2@j & !h1_3@j | !is_a@i & is_b@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i & !h1_1@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i | !h1_1@i & !h1_3@i)
h2_3 = rightmost(is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i & !is_a@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h1_3@j | is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_3@i & !is_a@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h1_3@j, !is_bos@i & !is_a@i & is_b@i & !h1_1@i | !is_a@i & is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i & !h1_1@j)
accept = h1_2 & h1_3 & h2_1 & !h2_3 | is_a & !is_b & !h2_2 & !h2_3

output accept
